subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Which branch should be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961: this narrower runtime-and-tests patch, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 with additional model-facing schema guidance?
rationale: Both branches address the same message-delivery invariant, neither is currently proof-positive, and choosing whether the extra schema wording belongs in the permanent contract requires one owner-visible branch decision.

options.title: Prove and use this branch
options.body: Require live channel proof on this narrower patch, then land it and close the competing PR once the canonical fix is established.

options.title: Adopt the schema-guidance branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if maintainers want omitted-final continuation stated explicitly in the projected tool schema, after equivalent live proof.

options.title: Pause for semantic redesign
options.body: Hold both branches only if source-reply completion telemetry and turn termination must be redesigned together rather than retaining their current separate meanings.

recommendation.title: Prove and use this branch
recommendation.body: Require live channel proof on this narrower patch, then land it and close the competing PR once the canonical fix is established.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch choice concerns the Codex source-reply bridge behavior introduced in their merged work.
